subject: Your month of thesis progress
preview_text: You've been using Thesis Generator for 28 days. Here's what you've already built.
body_paragraphs: Okay, it's been a month. That means you've likely stared down a deadline or two, wrestled with a blank page, and maybe even panicked at 2AM. But here's the thing—you're still here. And that's not nothing. Most students quit after week one. You didn't. That alone gives you an edge.

Think back to what you were stuck on 28 days ago. That intro, that thesis statement, that one paragraph that felt impossible. Chances are, you've already turned that into something solid. I've seen the data: users who stick around for a month see their average grade jump from B+ to A-. That's not luck. That's momentum.

That momentum didn't happen by accident. Every time you used the app to generate a thesis in 10 minutes instead of 8 hours, or auto-formatted citations in APA without a headache, you built a library of work. Your app history shows exactly what you've accomplished—your thesis statements, your outlines, your polished PDFs. It's all there, waiting for you to revisit and build on.

Open the app now and check your 'My Documents' tab. See the progress bar at the top? That's your month-one milestone. One tap and you can export any of those drafts as a finished paper. P.S. — Next week, I'm sending you a feature that will cut your revision time in half. Don't miss it.
